chunks: But if you deny, then many a people have denied before you. The duty of the apostle is to convey the message clearly.
ai.seo_question: What is the primary duty of the Prophet according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *al-Balagh al-Mubin* (clear conveyance), affirming that the Prophet’s duty is limited to delivering the message with clarity, while guidance (*hidayah*) rests solely with Allah. It serves as a historical reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) that rejection is not unique to his time, echoing the fate of earlier prophets like Noah and Abraham, thereby validating the continuity of the prophetic mission.
